commits.message:
Fix deploy script to preserve SSL configuration

- Modified deploy script to only create nginx config if it doesn't exist
- Prevents overwriting SSL configuration on subsequent deployments
- Preserves existing domain and SSL certificate setup

Fix JavaScript error: prevent appending null CategoryModal to DOM

- Added null check before appending CategoryModal to prevent Node.appendChild error
- CategoryModal returns null when modal is closed, causing appendChild to fail
- This was causing the 'Login failed: Node.appendChild: Argument 1 is not an object' error

Add manage categories button and modal functionality

- Added manage categories button to FilterControls component
- Integrated CategoryModal component with add/edit/delete functionality
- Added CSS styles for manage categories button
- Added modal state management and handlers in app.js
- Categories can now be created, renamed, and deleted through the UI
Fix missing dependencies: bcryptjs, cookie-parser, morgan

Add category filter functionality with multiple selection support

- Added category filter UI with buttons for each category
- Implemented multiple category selection (click to toggle, double-click for single)
- Fixed category filtering logic in separate view
- Fixed API request body serialization for todo updates
- Added proper Set handling in store state management
- Cleaned up debug code and temporary test files
- Category filter persists state across page reloads
- All functionality working with proper server synchronization

Initial commit: Clean Todo App with inline editing

- Full-featured todo application with authentication
- Inline editing for todo names (no modal)
- Drag and drop reordering
- Expandable todo items with notes, category, priority
- Responsive design with dark theme
- Offline support with service worker
- SQLite database backend
- Clean codebase with removed debug/test files
